features.name: land_frac
features.description: Share of the cell that is land
features.source: Natural Earth 1:50m land

features.name: ice_frac
features.description: Share of the cell under glaciers or ice sheets
features.source: Natural Earth 1:50m glaciated areas

features.name: lowsun_best_h
features.description: Hours per day with the Sun 0-5 deg above the horizon, mean of the best month
features.source: Computed from solar geometry (features/sun.py)

features.name: lowsun_mean_h
features.description: Hours per day with the Sun 0-5 deg above the horizon, annual mean
features.source: Computed from solar geometry (features/sun.py)

features.name: lowsun_best_month
features.description: Month (1-12) with the longest low-Sun time; round the decoded value
features.source: Computed from solar geometry (features/sun.py)

features.name: elev_mean_m
features.description: Mean elevation of the cell above the geoid
features.source: NASA SRTMGL30 (EOSDIS LP DAAC), computed by features/earth_terrain.py

features.name: relief_m
features.description: Elevation range P95-P5 inside the cell
features.source: NASA SRTMGL30 (EOSDIS LP DAAC), computed by features/earth_terrain.py

features.name: slope_mean_deg
features.description: Mean slope at a ~926 m step (Horn)
features.source: NASA SRTMGL30 (EOSDIS LP DAAC), computed by features/earth_terrain.py

features.name: slope_lt8

features.source: NASA SRTMGL30 (EOSDIS LP DAAC), computed by features/earth_terrain.py

features.name: slope_lt15
features.description: Share of the cell with slope under 15 deg (rover limit)
features.source: NASA SRTMGL30 (EOSDIS LP DAAC), computed by features/earth_terrain.py

features.name: rough_p50_m
features.description: Median RMS deviation of elevation in 3 x 3 pixel windows
features.source: NASA SRTMGL30 (EOSDIS LP DAAC), computed by features/earth_terrain.py

features.name: slope_h0

features.source: NASA SRTMGL30 (EOSDIS LP DAAC), computed by features/earth_terrain.py

features.name: min_calcite

features.source: NASA EMIT L3 ASA v002 (EOSDIS LP DAAC), computed by features/earth_surface.py

features.name: lst_day_mean_k
features.description: Mean daytime land surface temperature over the year (MODIS, clear sky). Above about 60 degrees the polar-night months are missing, so the mean is warm-biased there.
features.source: NASA MOD11C3 v061 (EOSDIS LP DAAC), monthly 2023, computed by features/earth_surface.py

features.name: lst_night_mean_k
features.description: Mean night-time land surface temperature over the year (MODIS, clear sky). Above about 60 degrees the polar-night months are missing, so the mean is warm-biased there.
features.source: NASA MOD11C3 v061 (EOSDIS LP DAAC), monthly 2023, computed by features/earth_surface.py

features.name: lst_day_max_k
features.description: Hottest monthly mean daytime temperature.
features.source: NASA MOD11C3 v061 (EOSDIS LP DAAC), monthly 2023, computed by features/earth_surface.py

features.name: lst_night_min_k
features.description: Coldest monthly mean night-time temperature. Above about 60 degrees the polar-night months are missing, so the mean is warm-biased there.
features.source: NASA MOD11C3 v061 (EOSDIS LP DAAC), monthly 2023, computed by features/earth_surface.py

features.name: lst_diurnal_k
features.description: Mean day minus night temperature (day-night swing), months with both values.
features.source: NASA MOD11C3 v061 (EOSDIS LP DAAC), monthly 2023, computed by features/earth_surface.py

features.name: ndvi_mean
features.description: Mean monthly NDVI over the year (greenness; below 0.1 is bare ground, rock, snow or ice).
features.source: NASA MOD13C2 v061 (EOSDIS LP DAAC), monthly 2023, computed by features/earth_surface.py

features.name: ndvi_max
features.description: Greenest monthly NDVI of the year.
features.source: NASA MOD13C2 v061 (EOSDIS LP DAAC), monthly 2023, computed by features/earth_surface.py

features.name: snow_cover_pct
features.description: Mean monthly snow cover over the months with a snow decision (MODIS). Polar-night months are missing.
features.source: NASA MOD10CM v061 (NSIDC DAAC), monthly 2023, computed by features/earth_surface.py

features.name: snow_free_months
features.description: Months with a snow decision and under 10 % snow cover (months without decision are not counted as free).
features.source: NASA MOD10CM v061 (NSIDC DAAC), monthly 2023, computed by features/earth_surface.py

features.name: barren_frac
features.description: Share of the cell's land that is barren ground at 500 m (IGBP class 16: rock, sand, bare soil, lava). Unlike mean NDVI it sees a bare patch inside a green cell.
features.source: NASA MCD12C1 v061 (EOSDIS LP DAAC), IGBP classes, computed by features/earth_surface.py

features.name: sparse_frac
features.description: Share of the cell's land that is barren or open shrubland (IGBP 16 and 7).
features.source: NASA MCD12C1 v061 (EOSDIS LP DAAC), IGBP classes, computed by features/earth_surface.py

features.name: snow_ice_frac
features.description: Share of the cell's land under permanent snow and ice at 500 m (IGBP class 15).
features.source: NASA MCD12C1 v061 (EOSDIS LP DAAC), IGBP classes, computed by features/earth_surface.py

features.name: volcano_dist_km
features.description: Distance from the cell to the nearest Holocene or Pleistocene volcano (one point per volcano or volcanic field).
features.source: Smithsonian GVP Volcanoes of the World (Holocene and Pleistocene), computed by features/context.py

features.name: impact_dist_km
features.description: Distance from the cell to the rim of the nearest known impact structure.
features.source: Wikipedia list of impact structures (Earth Impact Database) and Wikidata, computed by features/context.py

features.name: holocene_volcano_dist_km
features.description: Distance from the cell to the nearest Holocene volcano (active in the last 11,700 years: young, little eroded lava).
features.source: Smithsonian GVP Volcanoes of the World (Holocene and Pleistocene), computed by features/context.py

features.name: precip_log_mm
features.description: Annual precipitation on a log scale: 0 = none, 1 = 9 mm, 2 = 99 mm, 3 = 999 mm per year (GPM IMERG). Stored as a log so that hyper-arid deserts (a few mm per year) stay apart.
features.source: NASA GPM IMERG Final V07 monthly 2023 (GES DISC), computed by features/earth_surface.py

features.name: precip_min_log_mm
features.description: Annual precipitation of the driest 0.1 degree (about 11 km) land pixel inside the cell, same log scale: a salt basin is not hidden by the wetter hills around it.
features.source: NASA GPM IMERG Final V07 monthly 2023 (GES DISC), computed by features/earth_surface.py

features.name: bare_px_frac
features.description: Share of the 0.05 degree (about 5 km) pixels of the cell whose annual mean NDVI is at most 0.25: a bare volcano or salt flat inside a green cell still counts.
features.source: NASA MOD13C2 v061 (EOSDIS LP DAAC), monthly 2023, computed by features/earth_surface.py

features.name: snowfree_px_frac
features.description: Share of the 0.05 degree (about 5 km) pixels of the cell with at least one snow-free month: snow-free lowland next to a glacier still counts.
features.source: NASA MOD10CM v061 (NSIDC DAAC), monthly 2023, computed by features/earth_surface.py
